description: An oil-style painting of a dark, stormy evening. A stone church with a square tower and a steep roof stands on the right, its portal lit by torches. In the foreground, several men in dark tunics carry a large carved wooden chair on poles. Bishops in gold embroidered vestments and mitres walk toward the doorway, flanked by monks, torch-bearers and armoured men. A river with small boats lies to the left. There is no visible text, frame or border.
